text: Quick question—when we do panel interviews, is it better to do them in person or over video? I’ve seen both but not sure what’s preferred here.

Hey Ben, good question. We usually do panel interviews over video call. I think the idea is it’s less intimidating for candidates than sitting across from a whole group in person. It’s in the handbook somewhere, but yeah, video is the way to go.
Ah, that makes sense. Thanks Sam! I’ll set up a Zoom for the next one then.
